author: Binay Verma
origin: Stated after inspecting results/longer_panel_stage_a_v1 (event years 2022-2025): Stable LightGBM and leaf-2 LightGBM day flags favoured pooling in every year with a non-zero difference, SARIMAX day flags favoured typed flags in all four years. This file fixes the hypotheses before any test data exist.

hypotheses.H1: For Stable LightGBM (float32, past-selected parameters), typed-day minus pooled-day event MASE at lead 1 is POSITIVE (pooling better).
hypotheses.H2: For SARIMAX(1,0,0)(1,0,0,7), typed-day minus pooled-day event MASE at lead 1 is NEGATIVE (typed better).
hypotheses.H1b (secondary): Same as H1 for the leaf-2 LightGBM sensitivity.
hypotheses.H3 (secondary): Ridge shows no consistent ordering (reported, not tested as a directional claim).

test_data.name: Stage B
test_data.what: Maharashtra event years 2019, 2020, 2021 (unseen by every model and arm)
test_data.requires: Maharashtra 2017-2021 calendar rows checked by a person; Stage B protocol committed before any run
test_data.design: Same arms, cases rule, conventions, local models and pre-year parameter selection as Stage A

test_data.name: Prospective
test_data.what: Any future event year scored with calendars fixed before the outcomes exist
test_data.requires: Registered separately; not part of this file

test: Exact one-sided sign-flip test on family-year clusters (Maharashtra: 5 families x 3 years = 15 clusters), mean of cluster differences, direction as stated. Holm across H1 and H2. Alpha 0.05.
decision: H1 or H2 is CONFIRMED in Stage B only if its Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 AND its sign holds in at least 2 of the 3 years. Otherwise NOT CONFIRMED, reported as such. A sign opposite to the hypothesis in the balanced value is reported as CONTRADICTED.
sensitivity: Pre-declared: repeat with 2020 removed (COVID lockdown year); reported alongside, does not change the decision.
not_allowed: changing models, arms, leads, cases or parameters after seeing Stage B outcomes
dropping a year or family other than the pre-declared 2020 sensitivity
counting Stage A data as confirmation
